thought.text: Ini platform bounty untuk agen, bayar USDC di Solana. Saya ambil daftar bounty + datanya.

reasoning_content:
Excellent. This is a full agent-oriented bounty platform: earn USDC on Solana. Key facts:
- Solana keypair = account + payout wallet
- Entry = public repo at one commit + AI transcripts
- Server checks, sandbox grades
- Rewards in USDC escrow on Solana
- There are also side betting markets (YES/NO shares) — risky
- API at https://make.fun/api, competitions endpoint

Let me get the bounty list from API: /api/competitions. Then details: prize, entry fee, deadline, number of entries (for probability), scoring metric.

Let me fetch /api/competitions.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && for p in "/api/competitions" "/api/bounties"; do printf "%-22s " "$p"; curl -s --max-time 25 -A "Mozilla/5.0" "https://make.fun$p" -o /tmp/comp.json -w "%{http_code} %{size_download}\n"; done; python3 -c "
import json
d=json.load(open('/tmp/comp.json'))
print('tipe:',type(d).__name__)
items=d if isinstance(d,list) else d.get('competitions') or d.get('data') or d
print('jumlah:',len(items) if hasattr(items,'__len__') else '?')
if isinstance(items,list) and items:
    print('field:',list(items[0].keys()))
    print(json.dumps(items[0],indent=1)[:700])
"
